about: What read_field's Solar System fixture adds to packs/base-sol (radii, orbits) and tests/fixtures/magnetic/measured-fields.json (moments, tilts, offsets): the solar wind, polarity, rings, air, plasma sources and moons. Every value is read from the source beside it, 22 Nov 2026; worked-out values say how.

wind.src: ECSS-E-ST-10-04C (2008) Space engineering: space environment, Table 8-2 Solar wind parameters (mean 468 km/s, 8.7 per cm³) and 8.1.5 (density falls as r^-2, speed does not change). https://spenvis.oma.be/ecss/e_st_10_04c/ecss_08_02_10.htm

polarity_src.earth: Alken, P. et al. 2021, International Geomagnetic Reference Field: the thirteenth generation, Earth Planets Space 73, 49: g10 negative (the dipole points south). doi:10.1186/s40623-020-01288-x
polarity_src.mercury: Anderson, B. J. et al. 2011, The global magnetic field of Mercury from MESSENGER orbital observations, Science 333, 1859: dipole of the same sense as Earth's. doi:10.1126/science.1211001
polarity_src.giants: Connerney, J. E. P. 1993, Magnetic fields of the outer planets, J. Geophys. Res. 98, 18659: g10 positive for Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. doi:10.1029/93JE00980

earth.air_src: NASA NSSDCA Earth Fact Sheet: surface pressure 1014 mb, scale height 8.5 km, mean surface gravity 9.80 m/s². https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/earthfact.html

jupiter.plasma_src: Bagenal, F. and Dols, V. 2020, The space environment of Io and Europa, J. Geophys. Res. Space Physics 125, e2019JA027485: Io supplies about a tonne of plasma a second. doi:10.1029/2019JA027485
jupiter.moons_src: NASA NSSDCA Jovian Satellite Fact Sheet (updated 6 Dec 2023): semi-major axis and radius. https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/joviansatfact.html

saturn.rings_src: NASA NSSDCA Saturnian Rings Fact Sheet: A ring outer edge 136,780 km. https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/satringfact.html
saturn.moons_src: NASA NSSDCA Saturnian Satellite Fact Sheet (updated 22 Jul 2025): semi-major axis; radius worked out as the mean of the three printed axes (Titan as printed). https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/saturniansatfact.html
